summary: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints teaches that after death the spirit lives on, with the righteous in spirit paradise, that all people will be resurrected, and that God will judge according to desires and obedience. Its Kingdoms of Glory page says there are three kingdoms of glory, celestial, terrestrial and telestial; those who "received not the gospel of Christ" receive telestial glory after being redeemed from spirit prison, and only the sons of perdition, who are not worthy of any kingdom of glory, inherit none. The Articles of Faith say Christ will personally reign on the earth. The page treats "spirit prison", sometimes called hell, as temporary for most.

points.question: What is the final state of the wicked?
points.answer: Most people inherit some kingdom of glory; those who rejected the gospel inherit the telestial kingdom after release from spirit prison, and only sons of perdition inherit no kingdom of glory.

points.question: What happens when Christ returns?
points.answer: All will be resurrected and judged according to their desires and obedience; the Articles of Faith say Christ will personally reign on the earth.
